finding.summary: _provider_error() classifies a provider error object by inspecting the traceback's last frame name ('_create_chat_result'), a LangChain-internal implementation detail. If langchain_openai is refactored (function renamed, error wrapped/re-raised by tracing or retry machinery, or raised from a helper), the check silently fails and deterministic provider errors (e.g. 'model not found' returned in a 200 body) are misclassified as _Malformed and retried ATTEMPTS times with backoff — the exact behavior the old ProviderError class existed to prevent. The pinning test only detects the breakage after an upgrade has already changed runtime behavior.
finding.fix: Match on a structural property of the error instead of a frame name, e.g. accept any ValueError whose single arg is a dict containing an 'error'-shaped payload (or whose str() looks like an error object), or catch the specific exception type langchain_openai exports for this case if one exists. Keep the traceback check only as an additional narrowing signal, not the sole gate.
